slots.name: prison days
slots.sentence: After nearly four decades of public life, three presidential losses and three wins, 580 days in prison, and a return to power that few believed possible, Lula heads into Sunday’s election without the favourable poll numbers of the past and with a deeply polarised country.

slots.name: election vote share
slots.sentence: Lula won the presidency in 2002 with more than 60 percent of second-round votes becoming the country’s first labourer elected to the Planalto palace. He was re-elected four years later.

slots.name: people out poverty
